title: Introduction to sets
competency: Explain what is meant by a set and by an element.

keywords.def: We can clearly decide if an object belongs or not.
One of the objects in a set. Also called a member.
A set with no element. Written { } or ∅.

en.text: A set is a collection of well-defined objects. Well-defined means we can clearly decide if an object belongs. The vowels a, e, i, o, u form a set. The tall students in a class do not, because tall is not clear.

screens.title: Tall students
screens.ask: Can we write "all the tall students in your class" as a set?
opts: Yes, everyone agrees who is tall
Only if the class is small
screens.after: People disagree about who is tall. There is no clear rule, so it is not a set. A set needs a clear rule.

screens.title: 1.1 Introduction to sets
paras: In mathematics, a set describes a collection of objects.
Each object must be well-defined. We must be able to decide if it belongs or not.

screens.title: Definition 1.1
paras: Set is a collection of well-defined objects.
The objects in a set are called members or elements.
We list the elements between braces { }, separated by commas.
We name sets with capital letters, like A = {a, e, i, o, u}.
screens.note: Each element is listed once. The order does not matter.

screens.title: Set or not a set?
items: A set: {0, 1, 2, 3}. The rule is clear.
Five most talented writers of Ethiopia
Not a set. No rule says who is "most talented".
A set: {a, e, i, o, u}.

screens.title: Key words
defs: We can clearly decide if an object belongs or not.

opts: The intelligent students in your class
The months of the year that start with "J"
The best footballers in Addis Ababa
screens.ans: The months of the year that start with "J"
screens.why: For every month we can clearly say yes or no. "Intelligent" and "best" are not clear.
screens.clue: Which one has a clear yes/no rule?

screens.title: Sort the collections
screens.why: A set needs a clear rule for belonging.
screens.clue: Ask: could two people disagree about it?

screens.ask: The set of vowels in the English alphabet is A = {a, e, ___, o, u}.
screens.why: The vowels are a, e, i, o, u.
screens.clue: Which vowel comes between e and o?

screens.text: Hana says: "The set of large numbers is a set." Is she right?
opts: Yes, but only for whole numbers
screens.why: Is 100 large? Is 1,000? People disagree, so there is no clear rule. "Numbers greater than 100" would be a set.
screens.clue: Could two people disagree about which numbers are large?

en.text: The objects in a set are its elements. We write a ∈ A when a is an element of A. We write a ∉ A when it is not. For N = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10}, 6 ∈ N and 3 ∉ N.

screens.title: Is it inside?
screens.after: 3 is not listed between the braces. So 3 is not an element of N.

screens.title: Elements
paras: If a is a member of set A, we write a ∈ A. Read: a is an element of A.
If a is not a member of A, we write a ∉ A. Read: a is not an element of A.

screens.title: True or false?
steps: a. 6 ∈ N is true: 6 is in N.
b. 12 ∉ N is true: 12 is not in N.
c. 3 ∈ N is false: 3 is not in N.
d. 2 ∉ N is false: 2 is in N.

screens.title: Key words
defs: One of the objects in a set. Also called a member.

screens.why: 0 is not listed. 0.5 is a different number.
The dots continue the pattern: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, … So 10 is in the set.
screens.clue: Continue the pattern: add 2 each time.

screens.text: A = {1, 3, 5, 7, 9}. Tap every number that is ∉ A.
screens.why: 2, 6 and 10 are not listed in A.
The set continues 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, … (odd numbers). 8 is even, so 8 is not in it. "8 ∉" is true.
screens.clue: Continue the pattern. Is 8 ever reached?

ideas.name: Counting elements and the empty set

en.text: A repeated element counts once, so {1, 2, 4, 1} has 3 elements. A set with no element is the empty set, written { } or ∅. The set of cats that can fly is empty.

screens.title: A hundred years old
screens.ask: List all students in your class who are 100 years old. How many are there?
screens.after: Nobody in your class is 100. The list is empty. We call it the empty set.

screens.title: How many elements?
paras: Repeating an element does not add a new element.
There is no whole number less than 0. So that set has no element.
screens.note: Natural numbers start at 1. Whole numbers start at 0.

screens.title: Note
paras: A set with no element is called the empty set.
We use { } or ∅ for the empty set.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A set with no element. Written { } or ∅.

screens.text: Which set is the empty set?
opts: The set of rivers in Ethiopia
The set of whole numbers between 4 and 5
The set of whole numbers less than 4
screens.ans: The set of whole numbers between 4 and 5
screens.why: After 4 the next whole number is 5. Nothing is between them.
screens.clue: Is there a whole number between 4 and 5?
How many different numbers are listed?

screens.ask: D = the set of whole numbers less than 6. D has ___ elements.

screens.title: Empty or not?
screens.why: An empty set has no element at all.
screens.clue: Can you name even one element?

screens.text: Which of these is NOT the empty set?
screens.why: {0} has one element, the number 0. So it is not empty. { } and ∅ are empty, and no natural number lies between 20 and 21.
screens.clue: Count the elements inside the braces.

screens.title: Natural and whole numbers
steps: Natural numbers are the counting numbers: 1, 2, 3, 4, …
Whole numbers are the natural numbers and 0: 0, 1, 2, 3, …
So 0 is a whole number but not a natural number.

screens.text: How many whole numbers are less than 3?

items.why: 0 is not listed in the set.
1 is in the set, so "1 ∉" is false.
The set is the odd numbers. 8 is even.

items.text: Is "the collection of intelligent students in your class" a set?
Is "the months of the year which start with letter J" a set?
Is "the natural numbers between 20 and 21" a set?
items.why: The rule is clear, but nothing fits it. So it is the empty set.
items.clue: A clear rule with no members still gives a set.

items.why: a and b are two different elements.

items.text: M = the set of students in your class whose age is 30 years. Is M empty?
items.why: No Grade 7 student is 30 years old.

opts: The kind people in your town
test.why: It is {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}. The other rules are not clear.

test.text: A = {a, e, i, o, u}. True or false: b ∈ A.
test.why: b is not a vowel, so b ∉ A.
Whole numbers start at 0, so none is less than 0. {0} has one element; even numbers less than 3 are 0 and 2.

test.ask: E = the set of natural numbers less than 10 that are even. E has ___ elements.
test.why: E = {2, 4, 6, 8}. Natural numbers start at 1, so 0 is not included.
